findings.title: Elemental resistances are capped with a healthy overcap
findings.detail: The level 46 export explicitly sets resistancePenalty=0. Fire, Cold, and Lightning are each capped at 75%, with +40%, +44%, and +5% overcap respectively. Chaos Resistance is 0%.
findings.action: Keep the current elemental caps; Lightning has the smallest cushion. Pick up Chaos Resistance when it fits without losing Life.

findings.title: Mana has improved since the previous snapshot
findings.detail: Mana is 387 with 76 unreserved (19.6%) and 10.8 Mana regeneration per second, up from 48 unreserved and 10/sec. Reservation Efficiency is allocated. The selected active skill remains Flame Dash, so its 17 Mana cost and 5.34 Mana/sec are not Pyroclast Mine costs.
findings.action: Test a full mine sequence plus an escape in game. Keep the mana flask, and select Pyroclast Mine in PoB before using its cost readout.

findings.title: Keep building Life and Chaos defense
findings.detail: Life is 1645, Armour 735, physical maximum hit 1955, attack block 26%, and spell suppression 0%. Current PoB defensive calculations with resistancePenalty=0 show 4148 Total EHP, 6496 maximum hit for each elemental type, and 1645 Chaos maximum hit. At 0% Chaos Resistance, Chaos remains the least protected.
findings.action: Continue Life investment and consider Tolerance next for Chaos Resistance plus poison/bleed avoidance. The route remains unallocated.

findings.title: Reservation Efficiency and Blood Siphon routes are now confirmed
findings.detail: Five new passive nodes complete both planned routes: Aura Effect 57736 → Reservation Efficiency 7594, and Trickery 35894 → Life 21835 → Blood Siphon 25058. The active tree now has 59 allocated nodes.
findings.action: Next planned title node is Tolerance 10511; it is still unallocated and must remain unconfirmed until a future export shows it.

findings.title: The Reliquarian ascendancy has no unique-derived effect allocated yet
findings.detail: The export still allocates the Reliquarian start and two Passive Point nodes. No item-display or unique-derived effect node is in the active tree.
findings.action: This is reasonable for this stage; later choose a display around a relevant unique you actually own.

findings.title: Two life flasks add stronger recovery options
findings.detail: The Hallowed Life Flask has 53% increased Amount Recovered with 33% reduced Recovery rate. The Sacred Life Flask applies 50% of recovery instantly and grants shock immunity if used while shocked.
findings.action: Keep both available; use the instant-recovery flask for emergencies.
